history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A cinematic, high-contrast, black and white, digital painting of a brooding, aristocratic young man with messy, dark hair and piercing eyes. He is looking directly at the viewer with an intense, confident gaze. He wears a black, open-collared shirt and a dark jacket, adorned with a silver pendant shaped like a stylized star or compass, and a similar, more elaborate brooch on his lapel. His left ear has a dangle earring.

The background is dark and abstract, with shattered glass effects and glowing, ethereal light rays. Large, stylized metallic text dominates the image: "ERREN" on the left and "LUX" on the right, with sharp, angular, brushstroke-like lettering. Between these words, near the bottom, are smaller motivational phrases: "FOCUS - GRIND - SUCCEED" on the left and "NO EXCUSES" on the right, separated by a small triangular emblem.

On the far left and right edges of the image, there are stylized logos featuring a crown with wings and the letters "E" and "L" respectively. The overall mood is one of power, ambition, and determination, with a touch of dark fantasy or gothic aesthetic. The lighting is dramatic, with strong highlights and deep shadows, emphasizing the contours of the man's face and the metallic textures of the text and accessories. The color palette is strictly monochrome, with shades of black, white, and silver.
